title: Hold a commercial operator licence
what: Offer a chemical application service for fee or reward (such as spraying) only under a commercial operator licence.

laws.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 1995 (Tas)

sources.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 1995 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not offer a service for fee or reward which involves – (a) the use of a prescribed chemical product; or (b) the use of chemical products of a class that is prescribed; or (c) the use of a chemical product in a prescribed manner – unless that person holds a commercial operator licence
